name: scubaanywhere
description: Browser-based SCuBA assessment for Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. OAuth in, ephemeral report out.

scripts.setup: npm run vendor && npm run policies && npm run baselines && npm run gws-tables
scripts.build: npm run build -w @scubaanywhere/core && npm run build -w @scubaanywhere/relay && npm run build -w @scubaanywhere/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @scubaanywhere/core && npm run test -w @scubaanywhere/relay
